rows.name: Ryan Poehling
rows.note: Poehling (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Ducks on Wednesday.

rows.name: Ian Moore
rows.note: Moore (lower body) might be an option to play by the end of the week, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Wednesday.

rows.name: A.J. Greer
rows.note: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

rows.name: James Hagens
rows.note: Head coach Marco Sturm announced Saturday that Hagens (back) is expected to miss multiple weeks, per Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now.

rows.name: Justin Danforth
rows.note: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.

rows.name: Matt Grzelcyk
rows.note: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

rows.name: Kevin Bahl
rows.note: Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.

rows.name: Jonathan Huberdeau
rows.note: Huberdeau (hip) took the ice in a regular jersey Friday, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

rows.name: Jordan Staal
rows.note: Staal (calf) will be a game-time decision versus the Kraken on Saturday after head coach Rod Brind'Amour told reporters, "So, we'll find out probably tomorrow after you know gets through the morning, and hopefully he does play," per Tom Gulitti of NHL.com.

rows.name: Bowen Byram
rows.note: Byram (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

rows.name: Lian Bichsel
rows.note: Bichsel (lower body) is expected to miss at least two games after getting injured Thursday versus the Jets, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports.

rows.name: Oskar Back
rows.note: Back was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday.

rows.name: Albert Johansson
rows.note: Johansson (undisclosed) will be with the Red Wings for their upcoming four-game road trip, Ansar Khan of MLive.com reports Friday.

rows.name: Simon Edvinsson
rows.note: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

rows.name: Alec Regula
rows.note: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

rows.name: Matt Savoie
rows.note: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

rows.name: Mattias Janmark
rows.note: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

rows.name: Brad Marchand
rows.note: Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Marchand (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

rows.name: Aleksander Barkov
rows.note: Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Barkov (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

rows.name: Jonah Gadjovich
rows.note: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.

rows.name: Brock Faber
rows.note: Faber (skull) has told the Wild that he's ready to play and expects to return for Saturday's game against the Bruins, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports Wednesday.

rows.name: Ivan Demidov
rows.note: Demidov (foot) skated Tuesday and could resume training with the team next week, Patrick Friolet of RDS reports.

rows.name: Johnathan Kovacevic
rows.note: Kovacevic (undisclosed) is undergoing imaging Thursday and won't play in the Devils' home matchup against the Capitals, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports.

rows.name: Anthony Mantha
rows.note: Mantha (throat) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Devils on Wednesday, retroactive to Nov. 7.

rows.name: Seamus Casey
rows.note: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.

rows.name: Mathew Barzal
rows.note: Barzal (knee) won't be in the lineup against the Sharks on Monday but has been upgraded to day-to-day, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports.

rows.name: Sean Durzi
rows.note: Durzi (undisclosed) was put on injured reserve Thursday, per Mollie Walker of the New York Post.

rows.name: Joe Veleno
rows.note: Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: Warren Foegele
rows.note: Foegele (knee) will miss 3-4 weeks, Jackson Starr of the Senators' official site reports Saturday.

rows.name: William Eklund
rows.note: Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.

rows.name: Nikita Grebenkin
rows.note: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.

rows.name: Elmer Soderblom
rows.note: Soderblom (upper body) is week-to-week, per Penguins PR on Monday.

rows.name: Bryan Rust
rows.note: Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.

rows.name: Ryan Graves
rows.note: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

rows.name: Quentin Musty
rows.note: Musty (upper body) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday, according to Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

rows.name: Jacob Melanson
rows.note: Melanson (chest) will be a game-time call for Saturday's clash with the Hurricanes, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

rows.name: Ryan Lindgren
rows.note: Lindgren (upper body) will be a game-time decision ahead of Saturday's matchup with Carolina, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

rows.name: Jared McCann
rows.note: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

rows.name: Jake O'Brien
rows.note: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.

rows.name: Torey Krug
rows.note: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.

rows.name: Tyler Tucker
rows.note: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

rows.name: Miles Wood
rows.note: Wood (undisclosed) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

rows.name: Nick Blankenburg
rows.note: Blankenburg (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Maple Leafs on Friday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

rows.name: Max Domi
rows.note: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.

rows.name: Nate Schmidt
rows.note: The Mammoth announced Thursday that Schmidt (upper body) is considered week-to-week, Cole Bagley of KSL Sports reports.

rows.name: Filip Chytil
rows.note: Chytil (shoulder) looks set to return to the lineup against the Rangers on Friday, Jeff Paterson of CanucksArmy.com reports.

rows.name: Rasmus Sandin
rows.note: Sandin (knee) will be with the Capitals for their two-game road trip, Tarik El-Bashir of Monumental Sports Network reports Monday.

rows.name: Nick Bjugstad
rows.note: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.
